favourites.quote: O man you are busy working for the world, and the world is busy trying to turn you out.
favourites.author: Abu Bakr (R.A)

favourites.quote: The less of the World, the freer you live.
favourites.author: Umar ibn Al-Khattāb (R.A)

favourites.quote: No One Would Choose A Friendless Existence On Condition Of Having All The Other Things In The World.
favourites.author: Aristotle

favourites.quote: When I am silent, I have thunder hidden inside.
favourites.author: Rumi

favourites.quote: Everyone has been made for some particular work, and the desire for that work has been put in every heart.
favourites.author: Rumi

favourites.quote: If You Are Out To Describe The Truth, Leave Elegance To The Tailor.
favourites.author: Albert Einstein
